measurementNotes: First query means absent result cache; SQLite graph was already built.
Warm value is the arithmetic mean of repetitions 2 and 3.
Each repetition uses a new pwsh process.
Durations are one Windows machine; no production or CI timing claims.
Quality observations use the baseline committed projections; they are existing regression corpora, not newly blind data.
Standalone symbol generation and pipeline timing differ in concurrency and cache state; this is not a controlled speedup experiment.
Raw logs and diagnostic generators remain in .artifacts/wiki-analysis.
